title: Visual executor
description: Run the visual regression tests with the browser in Playwright's Docker image, so screenshots render the same on every machine (ADR-0021).

config.description: Workspace-relative Playwright config of the visual tests.

update.description: Rewrite the baselines instead of comparing with them.

image.description: Playwright Docker image; its version must match the installed @playwright/test.

port.description: Host port of the browser server in the container.
